description: Read the current ordered last-match-wins Operator enablement policy, rule identifiers, updated_at optimistic correction premise, catalog flags with provenance, and bounded immutable policy_change history. Default history_limit is 20; valid range 1..100. No current policy means explicit all-on and an advisory; initial create uses expected_updated_at=null. Disabled, withdrawn and unscored cells remain visible. Reading changes no state and requires no Operator role.
embedding_description: Read the current ordered last-match-wins Operator enablement policy, rule identifiers, updated_at optimistic correction premise, catalog flags with provenance, and bounded immutable policy_change history.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: rules, updated_at, cells with enabled and enabled_provenance, history (latest immutable existing policy_change refresh runs), and advisory warnings when uninitialized.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show the current policy decisions and provenance clearly. Preserve full immutable history in evidence; explain advisories without blocking progress.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Use the current updated_at premise for subsequent Operator corrections; never bypass disabled cells with a pin.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Typed StateManagementInterface catalog policy lifecycle; no network, deployment, drain or session actions.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: parameter_invalid: supply integer history_limit in 1..100. policy_invalid: malformed stored policy is an integrity fault; inspect it rather than silently resetting. state_service_unavailable: restore the state service binding. For mutation use set_model_cells_enabled as the current Operator, passing updated_at from this read.
